source_review: fc81fb76: The internal heuristic and its empty-input API have no runtime caller. Actual SILK frame classification belongs to VAD, pitch and noise shaping; these deleted heuristic expectations are not C parity checks.

fc81fb76: The arbitrary lag-range and nil-input helper API has no runtime caller. Actual pitch analysis has independent selected-C lag, contour and LTPCorr gates; those gates do not execute this deleted interface.
fc81fb76: The gain/voicing/LSF/stereo mutation getter/setter interface is absent. No current API exposes the round-trip contract tested by these accessors.
fc81fb76: The external VADFrameState injection API is absent. silk_Encode computes VAD internally; injection equality is not a current callable contract or an exact replacement for a live-C FEC test.
